messages:
Eli Chen: @Priya quick heads-up — Acme Systems needs SOC2 evidence + a signed pen-test letter for the POC. timeline: they want everything by next Friday. can we assemble a bundle?
Priya Nair: Thanks Eli. Which environment are they testing against? hosted or dedicated? that changes the pen-test scope.
Eli Chen: Sales said dedicated (reserved capacity) for the POC. they asked for "assurance pack" + explicit statement about network isolation and key custody.
Jesse Park: I can pull the SOC2 artifact set (control matrix, mapping doc, and supporting evidence list). for the signed pen-test letter — do you want our standard wording or custom language for legal?
Marta Lopez: Can we speed up the signed letter? legal is out, might take 2 business days. we can provide an interim pen-test attestation PDF signed by the security lead. that usually satisfies procurement for POCs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya Nair: For dedicated infra we need to confirm: 1) IP ranges they'll scan, 2) test window, 3) whether they'll use creds or unauthenticated scans. Please ask customer.
Eli Chen: I'll ask and get that by EOD. also they asked pricing — whether POC incurs any Dedicated minimum commitment. Sales confirmed short-term POC can be covered under an eval credit, but we need to confirm capacity availability.
Jesse Park: FYI the SOC2 zip will include: SOC2 report summary, control mapping CSV, retained evidence list, SSO configs (SAML audit), and incident response runbook excerpt. I can redact internal hostnames.
Priya Nair: Draft pen-test letter (we use this for POCs):

```
Redwood Inference
Penetration Test Letter of Authorization

This letter authorizes Acme Systems (tester) to perform penetration testing against Redwood Inference Dedicated environment allocated to Acme Systems POC. Authorized IP ranges: <customer-supplied>. Test window: <dates>. Authorized activities: external network/host and application testing; no social engineering. Redwood will provide scoped credentials if requested. Redwood requests pre- and post-test notifications and immediate escalation for critical findings.

Signed,
Redwood Security
```

Priya Nair: Use that as a template — legal will append signatory name once they review.
Marta Lopez: Also adding: for ISO artifacts, we don't ship full audit workpapers. provide summary docs + our ISO cert and the policy index. that's what most buyers accept.
Eli Chen: Great. can we create a single downloadable bundle and share a short checklist for procurement? they asked for "one-click" readiness.
Jesse Park: I'll build a zip and upload to secure file share. ETA tomorrow morning. contents list will be in the bundle root: README.md + SOC2_summary.pdf + ISO27001_certificate.pdf + pen_test_template.pdf + evidence_index.csv
Marta Lopez: Add a short note about data handling during POC: logs retained X days, keys handled by KMS, no customer data exported. copy for legal: "During the POC, customer data will remain in the dedicated environment and will not be exported outside the agreed scope."
Eli Chen: Perfect. I'll send the customer an ask to confirm scan IPs and whether creds required. also asking whether they need a notary / company-stamped signature.
Priya Nair: If they need notary, escalate to Contracts. otherwise AuditBot can produce an interim attestation signed by the Security Lead (pdf).
AuditBot: Generated attestation token: att-2024-11-07-54xyz — downloadable for 7 days: https://files.redwood.example/att-2024-11-07-54xyz (expires 7d)
Eli Chen: Thanks. last Q — do we need to open a short-term dedicated pool if demand spikes during POC? ops team — pinging later.
Jesse Park: Ops note: if we need extra capacity >2x baseline, we may require a provisioning lead time of 24-48 hours. can allocate burst but need heads-up.
Marta Lopez: I'll draft the procurement checklist bullet points and send back here. will include legal/ops contacts and the pen-test letter template.
Eli Chen: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll update the customer once I have their scan scope and whether they need notary. :thumbsup:
